scenes.title: Arkady's nightmare
scenes.summary: After Samson's punch, Arkady has a feverish nightmare in the hospital about the soldering iron while a Moscow visitor takes a taxi to Hotel Brussels; at the listening post Captain Zavarzin returns from the cheburek shop toilet and Major Lavrov hears Arkady wake up holding his bandaged ear. Opening song.

scenes.title: Arturik the taxi driver
scenes.summary: Local taxi driver Arturik recognises Moscow political strategist Ilona from her past as a dancer in Sineozersk and locks the doors to take her to a sauna; when he refuses to stop, she pretends to agree and suggests pulling over under Devil's Bridge.

scenes.title: Breakfast in the kitchen
scenes.summary: Arkady returns to the communal flat with a bandaged head as Klavdia Viktorovna watches Lev Leshchenko on TV, complains that a cemetery plot next to her late husband Grisha costs a 150,000-rouble bribe, and scolds Arkady for eating her caviar and cognac; on TV news, the video of Samson throwing the mayor out the window goes viral.

scenes.title: At the car dealership
scenes.summary: Stepping out from the job centre queue, Samson sits inside a luxury SUV at the Sinicar dealership and asks about a test drive; the salesman says test drives are only for regular clients, and Nina drags Samson back.

scenes.title: Under Devil's Bridge
scenes.summary: Under Devil's Bridge Ilona tricks Arturik into stepping out to the back seat, locks the doors, and drives off in his taxi while he chases after the car.

scenes.title: Golovkin's secret
scenes.summary: Waiting outside the investigator's room, Arkady is approached by public defender Danila Golovkin, who confesses he cannot give up the case because he has been secretly in love with Nina since first grade; Arkady threatens to tell Samson unless Golovkin obeys him, then is called in to see Pasha.

scenes.title: The job centre
scenes.summary: At the employment centre the clerk offers Samson a job as a supermarket loader or a street promoter in a giant waffle-cone costume; Nina refuses the loader job because of his back and makes him take the waffle-cone job for 700 roubles a day.

scenes.title: Pasha's new offer
scenes.summary: Over delicacies at the investigator's office, Pasha offers Arkady five million and a suspended sentence; Arkady calls him Judas, shows him the viral video with four million views making Samson a national hero, and tells Pasha that Samson is the future mayor of Sineozersk.

scenes.title: The waffle-cone costume
scenes.summary: Standing on the street in a giant waffle-cone costume, Samson argues with Nina that the job is humiliating until passers-by recognise him from the viral video and crowd around him for photos.

scenes.title: The future mayor
scenes.summary: Arkady invents a campaign slogan ('Everyone talks, while I get things done!') while the agents watch through binoculars; when Samson storms in angry at Yulia for posting the video, Arkady calms the family and proclaims Ivan Vasilyevich Samsonov the future mayor of Sineozersk.

scenes.title: The chance of a lifetime
scenes.summary: Samson complains that Arkady has ruined his quiet life and tries to shut him out, but Arkady has Nina and Yulia read out glowing online comments calling Samson the pride of Russia, promises Nina she will be the mayor's wife, and admits Samson will help him get free once elected.

scenes.title: Courtyard press conference
scenes.summary: At an impromptu press conference in the courtyard, Arkady thanks Samson for teaching him a lesson and announces that Samson is running for mayor; Nina gives reporters the campaign phone number, and TV news broadcasts Samson's candidacy across the city.

scenes.title: The strategist from Moscow
scenes.summary: At Pasha's campaign headquarters a focus group pitches a clumsy rhyming slogan for pensioners until Moscow strategist Ilona Leonidovna arrives as the new campaign head and scraps it; Ksyusha reports an emergency: Ivan Samsonov has entered the race.

scenes.title: The governor's order
scenes.summary: While posing for a winter jogging photo in the park, Governor Viktor Stepanovich calls Pasha by video link and orders him to eliminate Samsonov politically; afterwards Ilona complains that nobody met her at the station, and Pasha coldly tells her the budget was cut and demands results.

scenes.title: The candidate's look
scenes.summary: As Yulia answers voter calls, Arkady rejects Samson's old wedding suit and picks a simple caramel-cream sweater and jacket for his man-of-the-people image; when Slavik brings free beer from the brewery, Arkady forbids Samson to drink and asks Nina to keep watch over him.

scenes.title: Klavdia's kompromat
scenes.summary: In the hallway Klavdia Viktorovna shows Arkady a phone video of Samson drunk and rowdy and threatens to sell it to LifeNews for 15,000 roubles unless Arkady gets her a 40-inch 3D Smart TV with glasses by evening.

scenes.title: Our main enemy
scenes.summary: Ilona arrives at the communal flat to make Samson an offer from Osipenko's headquarters; Samson refers all offers to Anikeev, and Arkady warmly greets his old acquaintance Ilona while warning Samson and Nina that she is their smartest and most dangerous enemy.

scenes.title: Nothing personal
scenes.summary: In his room Arkady tries to hire Ilona onto Samson's campaign for ten times the pay, but she refuses to risk her unbeaten reputation; Klavdia bursts in demanding her TV by evening, and as Ilona leaves she stops in the hallway to ask Klavdia what issue she has with Anikeev.

scenes.title: Good deeds
scenes.summary: Samson, Nina and Yulia film campaign videos around the city rescuing a cat, beating rugs and carrying heavy timber under the slogan 'Everyone talks, while I get things done!'; Yulia reports invitations from the Italian restaurant Francesco and the Society of the Blind.

scenes.title: Battle for the television
scenes.summary: Golovkin brings a 47,000-rouble TV for Klavdia Viktorovna, but Arkady finds Ilona already in Klavdia's room with an even bigger Smart TV; just as Klavdia hands over her phone, Arkady tops Ilona's offer by promising Klavdia a cemetery plot next to her husband Grisha.

scenes.title: A task for the lawyer
scenes.summary: In the hallway Arkady gives Golovkin 150,000 roubles in an envelope and instructs him how to bribe the cemetery administrator Lisitsyn; when Golovkin objects to bribery, Arkady threatens to fire him so he never sees Nina again.

scenes.title: The exclusive test drive
scenes.summary: Cutting through the Sinicar showroom on the way to the Society of the Blind, Samson is offered a free test drive of the luxury SUV until 10 p.m. by the apologetic manager; while Nina buys sparkling water, Samson pulls up in the SUV and takes her for a fast ride.

scenes.title: The cemetery plot
scenes.summary: Arkady and Golovkin bring Klavdia her official cemetery certificate next to Grigory Soprykin, but Ilona bursts in with a church decree from Bishop Yafan blessing the reburial of Grigory and Klavdia in the cathedral crypt; Arkady begs Klavdia to wait one second before giving up her phone.

scenes.title: Lev Leshchenko's call
scenes.summary: Arkady puts Lev Leshchenko on the phone to thank Klavdia Viktorovna personally; moved to tears after a lifetime at the chemical plant, Klavdia throws the phone on the table and walks out, and Ilona grabs it and locks herself in the bathroom to forward the video.

scenes.title: Dinner at Francesco's
scenes.summary: Instead of going to the Society of the Blind, Samson persuades Nina to use their free 7,000-rouble deposit at the Italian restaurant Francesco, where they toast their new life with rosé sparkling wine, a seafood tower and ravioli.

scenes.title: Old scores
scenes.summary: Pasha approves the video of drunk Samson for upload; when Ilona asks Pasha to move his former classmate Anikeev to better conditions since Anikeev lacks even bed linen, Pasha insults her past and threatens to fire her if she brings Arkady so much as a pillow.

scenes.title: Outside the restaurant
scenes.summary: Tipsy after dinner, Nina scolds Samson for drinking, and Samson persuades her to let him drive carefully 400 metres through the courtyards.

scenes.title: Joining the uprising
scenes.summary: While Golovkin tells Arkady how to shave a year off his sentence, Ilona arrives at the flat with a pillow, blanket and vodka, announces she deleted the video of Samson and is joining their campaign, and begins planning how to make Samson a people's hero.

scenes.title: Night race
scenes.summary: Speeding back toward the showroom before 10 p.m., tipsy Samson spots a police patrol car, swerves through the courtyards he knows by heart, and launches the SUV over a ramp straight into the dealership window.

scenes.title: An extension for Osipenko
scenes.summary: In their car the Moscow partners Stepan Gennadyevich and Fyodor Grigoryevich play fake airport background noise and phone Pasha to grant him an extension so he gathers more cash, then head off to sleep. Closing song.
